prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a new minimal bold geometric icon for kollens.
Input images: Images 1, 2, and 3 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Learn their strong solid straight-edge polygon planes, restrained negative-space construction, and abstract K character. Create an original silhouette rather than directly tracing any reference.
Direction: DIAGONAL CUT. A compact three-piece K-inspired mark constructed from one broad rising 45-degree diagonal slab, one upper-left geometric facet, and one lower-right geometric facet. Exactly THREE filled polygon pieces. Deliberate open negative-space cuts, equal visual widths, crisp controlled 45-degree slopes, coherent optical weight. Slightly more solid and compact than the second reference, broad enough to retain the cuts at 24 pixels.
Color and composition: flat exact gold #F9C932 on a plain near-black charcoal #101113 background, square canvas, a single centered icon approximately 60% of canvas width with generous outer margins.
No text, wordmark, TM, extra elements, outlines, curves, circles, 3D, gradients, grain, textures, lighting, shadows, mockups or watermark. Precision-first geometric logo design with three simple filled planes and clean sharp edges.
